A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and the internet. Your connection goes to a computer run by the VPN company first, and only then out to the websites you visit.

Because of that, websites see the VPN's address instead of yours, and your internet provider can't see which sites you open. On public Wi-Fi, like at a café or airport, it also keeps your data scrambled so others on the same network can't read it.

A VPN doesn't make you fully anonymous. The VPN company can still see your activity, so pick one you trust. It also won't protect you from scams or harmful downloads.

VPN ek private raasta hai jo aapke device aur internet ke beech banta hai. Aapka connection pehle VPN company ke computer par jaata hai, aur wahan se aap jo websites kholte ho unke paas.

Isliye websites ko aapka asli address nahi, VPN ka address dikhta hai, aur aapka internet provider dekh nahi pata ki aap kaun si sites khol rahe ho. Café ya airport ke public Wi-Fi par yeh aapka data scramble bhi kar deta hai, taaki same network ke doosre log use padh na sakein.

VPN aapko poori tarah anonymous nahi banata. VPN company aapki activity dekh sakti hai, isliye bharosemand company chuno. Yeh scams ya nuksaan karne wali downloads se bhi nahi bachata.
